what: Nieman Lab reports that newsletter writer Virginia Sole-Smith said almost 50% of her subscribers had made the transition from Substack to Patreon. She criticized Substack's pivot toward turning readers into social media consumers as diverging from the goal of supporting writers.
verbatim_snippet: "Sole-Smith said almost 50% of her subscribers had made the transition."
notes: Same source as F-P01, different speaker. Passage from Google search index. The ~50% figure is Nieman Lab's paraphrase. Sole-Smith runs the "Burnt Toast" newsletter. Patreon reportedly promoted her migration via a Times Square billboard.
